linework.observation: Clean bold contours hold across the protagonist, crew, gauges, periscope column and valve wheels.

colour.observation: Muted navy, warm steel, cream and copper dominate; red warning lamps are localized and do not wash the room.

shading.observation: Cel shadows and simplified metal bands match the canonical illustrated system.

character_construction.observation: The central bald protagonist retains a rounded head, nose, ears, dark brows and mouth; other crew have hair and distinct profiles.

backgrounds.observation: Dense but readable submarine control room with gauges, controls, watertight doors, pipes and a ladder.

finish.observation: Polished image with strong focal placement; screen detail is simplified enough to remain illustrative.

identity.observation: The central figure is now clearly bald and matches the protagonist identity; surrounding crew remain visually distinct.

content.observation: Crew at stations and protagonist using a periscope fit a submarine control-room sequence; the circular upper structure reads as an internal access trunk, not a window.

composition.observation: Wide ensemble view keeps the central protagonist prominent while showing supporting operators and equipment.

regions.people_faces: One bald focal operator at the periscope; three supporting crew with dark hair and distinct faces.
regions.clothing: Navy coveralls across the crew, with the protagonist central and foregrounded.
regions.foreground_props: Periscope grips, charts, control levers and gauges organize the work.
regions.architecture: Pipe-filled room, hatch, ladder, equipment banks and floor grating read as an enclosed boat interior.
regions.distance: Operators and machinery layer behind the protagonist without losing focal hierarchy.
regions.lighting: Warm work lamps and limited red status indicators; restrained shadows and no full-frame red glow.
